(***********************************************************************)
(******          FeynRules add-on: Wprime model (Wprime_gen)     ******)
(******   Extracted from arXiv:hep-ph/0207290 (Zack Sullivan)     ******)
(******   Load on top of SM.fr (no M$GaugeGroups block)           ******)
(***********************************************************************)

(* All indices (Colour, Gluon, Generation, SU2D, SU2W) are declared by SM.fr;
   this model introduces no new index. *)

(* ************************** *)
(* *****  Information   ***** *)
(* ************************** *)

M$ModelName = "Wprime_gen";

M$Information = {
  Authors      -> {"Extracted from hep-ph/0207290"},
  Version      -> "1.0",
  Date         -> "2026",
  Institutions -> {"arXiv:hep-ph/0207290"},
  Emails       -> {"na"},
  URLs          -> "https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-ph/0207290"
};

(* ************************** *)
(* ***** Interaction orders ***** *)
(* ************************** *)

M$InteractionOrderHierarchy = {
  {QCD, 1},
  {QED, 2},
  {NP,  1}
};

(* ************************** *)
(* ***** Particle classes **** *)
(* ************************** *)

M$ClassesDescription = {

(* New heavy charged gauge boson W' (colour and SU(2) singlet, Q = +1) *)
  V[100] == {
    ClassName        -> Wp,
    SelfConjugate    -> False,
    Mass             -> {MWp, 500.},
    Width            -> {WWp, 16.195},
    QuantumNumbers   -> {Q -> 1},
    PDG              -> 34,
    PropagatorLabel  -> "Wp",
    PropagatorType   -> Sine,
    PropagatorArrow  -> Forward,
    ParticleName     -> "Wp",
    AntiParticleName -> "Wpbar",
    FullName         -> "W prime"
  },

(* Right-handed neutrinos, one per generation (mass eigenstates nu_R) *)
  F[100] == {
    ClassName        -> nur,
    ClassMembers     -> {nur1, nur2, nur3},
    Indices          -> {Index[Generation]},
    FlavorIndex      -> Generation,
    SelfConjugate    -> False,
    Mass             -> {Mnur, 0.},
    Width            -> 0,
    QuantumNumbers   -> {LeptonNumber -> 1},
    PDG              -> {18, 20, 22},
    PropagatorLabel  -> {"Nur", "Nur1", "Nur2", "Nur3"},
    PropagatorType   -> S,
    PropagatorArrow  -> Forward,
    ParticleName     -> {"Nur1", "Nur2", "Nur3"},
    AntiParticleName -> {"Nur1bar", "Nur2bar", "Nur3bar"},
    FullName         -> {"Right-handed neutrino 1", "Right-handed neutrino 2", "Right-handed neutrino 3"}
  }
};

(* ************************** *)
(* *****   Parameters   ***** *)
(* ************************** *)

M$Parameters = {

(* New gauge couplings, mixing angle and CP phase of Eq.(2) *)
  gR == {
    ParameterType    -> External,
    BlockName        -> WPRIME,
    OrderBlock       -> 1,
    Value            -> 0.653,
    InteractionOrder -> {NP, 1},
    TeX              -> Subscript[g, R],
    Description      -> "Right-handed W' gauge coupling, Eq.(2); g = Sqrt[8 mW^2 GF/Sqrt[2]] = 0.653"
  },
  gL == {
    ParameterType    -> External,
    BlockName        -> WPRIME,
    OrderBlock       -> 2,
    Value            -> 0.653,
    InteractionOrder -> {NP, 1},
    TeX              -> Subscript[g, L],
    Description      -> "Left-handed W' gauge coupling, Eq.(2)"
  },
  zeta == {
    ParameterType -> External,
    BlockName     -> WPRIME,
    OrderBlock    -> 3,
    Value         -> 0.,
    TeX           -> \[Zeta],
    Description   -> "Left-right mixing angle, Eq.(2); paper: |zeta| smaller than a few 10^-5 to 10^-2; 0 = purely right-handed benchmark"
  },
  omega == {
    ParameterType -> External,
    BlockName     -> WPRIME,
    OrderBlock    -> 4,
    Value         -> 0.,
    TeX           -> \[Omega],
    Description   -> "CP-violating phase of Eq.(2), absorbable into V^R"
  },

(* Generalised CKM (GCKM) matrices of Eq.(2): quark sector, Eq.(16) benchmark *)
  VLq == {
    ParameterType -> External,
    Indices       -> {Index[Generation], Index[Generation]},
    BlockName     -> VLBLOCK,
    OrderBlock    -> 1,
    Value         -> {
      VLq[1,1] -> 0.9751, VLq[1,2] -> 0.2215, VLq[1,3] -> 0.0035,
      VLq[2,1] -> 0.2210, VLq[2,2] -> 0.9743, VLq[2,3] -> 0.0410,
      VLq[3,1] -> 0.0090, VLq[3,2] -> 0.0400, VLq[3,3] -> 1.0000
    },
    TeX           -> Superscript[V, Lq],
    Description   -> "Left-handed GCKM matrix, quarks; benchmark = Eq.(16)"
  },
  VRq == {
    ParameterType -> External,
    Indices       -> {Index[Generation], Index[Generation]},
    BlockName     -> VRBLOCK,
    OrderBlock    -> 1,
    Value         -> {
      VRq[1,1] -> 0.9751, VRq[1,2] -> 0.2215, VRq[1,3] -> 0.0035,
      VRq[2,1] -> 0.2210, VRq[2,2] -> 0.9743, VRq[2,3] -> 0.0410,
      VRq[3,1] -> 0.0090, VRq[3,2] -> 0.0400, VRq[3,3] -> 1.0000
    },
    TeX           -> Superscript[V, Rq],
    Description   -> "Right-handed GCKM matrix, quarks; benchmark = Eq.(16)"
  },

(* Generalised CKM (GCKM) matrices of Eq.(2): lepton sector, identity benchmark *)
  VLl == {
    ParameterType -> External,
    Indices       -> {Index[Generation], Index[Generation]},
    BlockName     -> VLBLOCK,
    OrderBlock    -> 2,
    Value         -> {
      VLl[1,1] -> 1., VLl[1,2] -> 0., VLl[1,3] -> 0.,
      VLl[2,1] -> 0., VLl[2,2] -> 1., VLl[2,3] -> 0.,
      VLl[3,1] -> 0., VLl[3,2] -> 0., VLl[3,3] -> 1.
    },
    TeX           -> Superscript[V, Ll],
    Description   -> "Left-handed GCKM matrix, leptons; benchmark = identity matrix"
  },
  VRl == {
    ParameterType -> External,
    Indices       -> {Index[Generation], Index[Generation]},
    BlockName     -> VRBLOCK,
    OrderBlock    -> 2,
    Value         -> {
      VRl[1,1] -> 1., VRl[1,2] -> 0., VRl[1,3] -> 0.,
      VRl[2,1] -> 0., VRl[2,2] -> 1., VRl[2,3] -> 0.,
      VRl[3,1] -> 0., VRl[3,2] -> 0., VRl[3,3] -> 1.
    },
    TeX           -> Superscript[V, Rl],
    Description   -> "Right-handed GCKM matrix, leptons; benchmark = identity matrix"
  }
};

(* ************************** *)
(* *****   Lagrangian   ***** *)
(* ************************** *)

(* Free kinetic and mass term of the W' (complex vector, gauge singlet) *)
LWpkin := Block[{mu, nu},
  -1/2 FS[Wpbar, mu, nu] FS[Wp, mu, nu] + MWp^2 Wpbar[mu] Wp[mu]
];

(* Free kinetic and mass term of the right-handed neutrinos (Dirac fermions) *)
Lnurkin := Block[{mu},
  I nurbar.Ga[mu].DC[nur, mu] - Mnur nurbar.nur
];

(* W' couplings to fermions, Eqs.(1)-(2):
   L = 1/Sqrt[2] fbar_i gamma_mu (gR e^{i omega} Cos[zeta] V^R_ij P_R
       + gL Sin[zeta] V^L_ij P_L) W' f_j + H.c.
   Right-handed leptonic current uses the new nu_R field (W' -> l nu_R),
   left-handed leptonic current uses the SM neutrino (W' -> l nu). *)
LWpF := Block[{mu, LWpint},
  LWpint = ExpandIndices[
    (1/Sqrt[2]) Wp[mu] (
      gR Cos[zeta] Exp[I omega] (uqbar.VRq.Ga[mu].ProjP.dq + nurbar.VRl.Ga[mu].ProjP.l)
      + gL Sin[zeta] (uqbar.VLq.Ga[mu].ProjM.dq + vlbar.VLl.Ga[mu].ProjM.l)
    ),
    FlavorExpand -> Generation
  ];
  LWpint + HC[LWpint]
];

(* Total Lagrangian *)
LTotal := LWpkin + Lnurkin + LWpF;
